settings.heading: Ukuguqulelwa Komuntu Ngamunye
settings.description: I-Unity isebenzisa umsebenzi wakho wakamuva wasemakethe kanye nezinto ozikhethile ukuze ilungisele lokho okubonayo. Imiphumela Yosesho kanye Nezinhlu Ezixhaswe Ngemali azisoze zathinteka yilokhu.
settings.disabledNotice: Ukuguqulelwa komuntu ngamunye kuvaliwe. Uzobona ukutholakala okufanayo njengawo wonke umuntu. Usesho lusasebenza ngokwejwayelekile.
settings.clearHistoryDesc: Kususa umlando wakho wokubukwa kwakamuva. Ama-oda akho, ukubhukha, ukushintshanisa nokubuyekezwa akusoze kwathinteka.
settings.clearHistoryConfirmDesc: Lokhu kusetha kabusha umsebenzi wakho wakamuva obukiwe osetshenziswa ukwenza iziphakamiso. Izintshisekelo zakho ezisobala ngenhla zisala zilondoloziwe. Lokhu akukwazi ukuhlehliswa.
settings.clearHistorySuccess: Umlando wakho wokuguqulelwa komuntu ngamunye ususiwe.

errors.couldNotLoad: Ayikwazanga ukulayisha izilungiselelo zakho zokuguqulelwa komuntu ngamunye
errors.couldNotSave: Ayikwazanga ukulondoloza izilungiselelo zakho zokuguqulelwa komuntu ngamunye
errors.couldNotClear: Ayikwazanga ukususa umlando wakho wokuguqulelwa komuntu ngamunye

emptyState.noHistory: Phequlula izinto ezimbalwa futhi sizoqala ukulungisela leli khasi lakho.
